set.body: Scope: PRD Phase 4. Freeze the canonical descriptor value and receipt aggregation decisions, then implement one explicit representation-to-LNA binding that lowers typed logical slots to typed payload plans over the current store. Acceptance: memory and LNA interpreters return equivalent selected blocks; archive round trip preserves representation model and logical payload values exactly; whole-payload fallback is receipted honestly; external dependencies are content-verified; mathematical representation code imports no LNA or HDF5 types.
set.title: RRA 4: bind the migrated representation to LNA-HDF5
